providers.name: Aion Labs
providers.description: Permanent free tier, no credit card required. 15 RPM, 20K tokens/day. Specialized for roleplay and storytelling.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.description: Free "Trial" API key, no credit card. 1,000 API calls/month. Non-commercial use only.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.description: Free tier, no credit card. Free-tier prompts may be used by Google to improve products.

providers.name: Mistral AI
providers.description: Free mode, enabled by default, no credit card required. Free-mode prompts may be used to train Mistral models unless you opt out.

providers.name: Z AI (Zhipu AI)
providers.description: Permanent free models, no credit card required.

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.description: 10,000 Neurons/day free, no credit card required. 60+ models available on the free tier.

providers.name: Gonka Broker
providers.description: Permanent free tier, no credit card required; phone verification required. ~1M tokens/month (shared, varies by model), resets monthly. Model lineup rotates with network governance — live list at /v1/models.

providers.name: Groq
providers.description: Free tier, no credit card. Ultra-fast LPU inference.

providers.name: Kilo Code
providers.description: Free models with no credit card and no API key required. `kilo-auto/free` auto-router dynamically routes to models in the free pool.

providers.name: LLM7.io
providers.description: API gateway with a free tier. Anonymous access needs no key and reaches the `turbo` models; a free token from token.llm7.io raises the rate and token limits but reaches the same models.

providers.name: ModelScope
providers.description: Free API-Inference for registered users. Requires Alibaba Cloud account binding + real-name verification.

providers.name: NVIDIA NIM
providers.description: Free with NVIDIA Developer Program membership. 100+ models. Rate-limited per model.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.description: 17 free models (marked with `:free` suffix). OpenAI SDK-compatible.

providers.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
providers.description: Free anonymous tier (no API key, no signup): 2 RPM per IP per model. 20+ open-weight models hosted in EU. OpenAI SDK-compatible.

providers.name: SiliconFlow
providers.description: Permanently free models, no credit card required. Identity verification required. 100+ models in the catalog, most of them paid.

providers.name: Ollama Cloud
providers.description: Big open models run on Ollama's computers (nothing to download): Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1, Mistral Large 4, gpt-oss 120B and more. Free plan with usage limits. Ollama says it doesn't train on prompts. Never used for your private files.
